# LDBG

> LDBG is a free falling-block RPG you play in your browser. Every line you clear strikes a monster: gather on the Farm, craft gear, fight up the Greenshore dungeons and duel other players.

LDBG is a falling-block puzzle game and an RPG at once. You stack falling pieces and clear lines as in any competitive stacker, and every line you clear does something in the RPG: on the Farm it gathers materials, in a dungeon it strikes the monster in front of you, and in the Arena it hits another player. Your account keeps your character's level, gear, materials and unlocks between runs. It is made with the Godot engine by an independent developer and is in early beta.

- Play free in a desktop browser: https://redredret.github.io/ldbg/
- Official site: https://redredret.github.io/
- Optional Windows app: https://github.com/redredret/redredret.github.io/releases/latest
- Controls: keyboard or controller, every action rebindable. Built for computers, not phones.
- Price: free. Guests can try a local demo; logging in keeps progress on the game's servers.

## The game in numbers

- 133 items, including 61 pieces of gear (helmets, armour, swords, bows, staves, bucklers, rings, necklaces), from 96 crafting recipes
- 16 kinds of monster, 8 of them bosses
- 19 fights in the Greenshore story route
- 103 upgrades across 3 upgrade trees (Combat, Skills and Build)
- 46 quests from 7 townsfolk, and 72 daily and weekly tasks
- Live totals, read 2026-10-01: 22 adventurers, 2,097 monsters slain, 528 bosses slain, 720 Quads and 463 T-spins cleared, 722 Farm runs

## The Farm

The Farm is an endless run. Clear lines and you gather logs, ore, fish and fibre from the land around you, then carry it home to craft with. The better you stack, the more you bring back: quads, T-spins and combos all pay extra.

- **Farm Solo**: Just you and the board. Garbage rises every few pieces, so keep clearing.
- **Farm Versus**: Up to ten players in a room, sending garbage at each other. You keep everything you gather.
- **Dark Farm**: Versus with stakes. Half of what you gather is on the line, and the winner takes it.

## Crafting and gear

Smelt your ore into ingots, weave your fibre into fabric, and work them into 61 pieces of gear across 96 recipes. Everything you wear shows on your character, from helmets and armour to swords, bows, staves, bucklers, rings and necklaces. Trade the rest for Gold with other players on the Market.

## Dungeons

Greenshore's story runs 19 fights long, from zombies on the shore to the Cult Leader at the top of the tower. Your lines are your attacks. Theirs land on your board: arrows knock out blocks, fire spreads along the bottom row, and slime costs you a rotation.

- **Story**: One set route through every area and every boss.
- **Endless**: One dungeon made of regions, each ending in a reward chest. The deeper you go, the harder the regions and the better the chests. Go alone or bring a friend.
- **Dark**: Enemies at double strength, and other hunters on the loose. Monsters break your gear and you lose what you found; lose to a player and they take what you wear.
- **The Garbage Man**: 10 waves of garbage, faster every wave. One top-out ends it.
- **The Slime King**: A king after every king, alone or with a friend. He walls your board down to four columns until he falls.

## Bosses

- **Bandit King**: Switches between arrow rain and a blade spin that cuts your top and bottom rows.
- **Cyclops**: Knocks blocks loose from the top of your stack, then sets it on fire.
- **Punchy**: Slams the ground, and a stone wave sweeps across one of your rows.
- **Shooty**: Hurls boulders that drop three or four stone blocks onto your board.
- **Bernie**: A fire-casting cyclops whose fireball spreads along your bottom row.
- **Cult Leader**: Opens portals and hurls fireballs, then shields itself from your next hit.
- **The Garbage Man**: Throws garbage at you one line at a time, faster every wave. Beat wave ten for an Arcane Vault, then keep going.

## Lesser foes

- **Zombie**: Swipes a block off your top.
- **Super Zombie**: Rakes off two or three.
- **Slime**: Slimes your piece. No rotating.
- **Squirrel**: Nips at you. Never your board.
- **Bandit**: Arrows knock out a block.
- **Bandit Elite**: A tougher bandit, crossbow and all.
- **Cultist**: Fireballs, and a stab at your bottom row.
- **Oak Entling**: A stump that refused to stay felled.

## The Arena

In the Hollow Spire you pick your opponent off the board. Look over their gear first, then fight for the win, or put a piece of your gear against a piece of theirs. Every hit you land is a line you cleared, so the better stacker usually walks away richer.

## Questions

### What is LDBG?

LDBG is a free falling-block RPG you play in your browser. Every line you clear is an attack on the monster in front of you. You gather materials on the Farm, craft gear, fight up the Greenshore dungeons, and duel other players, and your account keeps your levels, gear and loot.

### Is LDBG free to play?

Yes. LDBG is free and plays in your browser at redredret.github.io/ldbg. Try it as a guest, or Log In so everything you earn is kept.

### Do I need to download anything?

No. It runs in a desktop browser such as Chrome, Edge or Firefox. There is also an optional Windows app that opens the same game in its own window, with extra settings like higher frame rates.

### What do I play it with?

A keyboard or a controller, on a computer. Every control can be rebound in Settings, and handling such as auto-repeat and soft drop speed can be tuned the way competitive stackers like it.

### How does the RPG side work?

Clearing lines gathers logs, ore, fish and fibre on the Farm, or deals damage in a dungeon. Bigger clears hit harder: Quads, T-spins and combos all pay extra. You earn XP and levels, spend points across 3 upgrade trees, craft and wear gear, finish quests and daily tasks, and open reward chests.

### Can I play with friends?

Yes. Farm Versus seats up to ten players who send garbage at each other, Dark Farm puts half your haul on the line, Endless and the Slime King can be fought with a friend, and the Arena lets you duel another player for the win or for each other's gear.

### Is my progress saved?

When you Log In, your progress is kept on the game's servers and follows you to any computer. Guest play is a short local demo, and nothing earned as a guest moves to an account.

### Is LDBG finished?

No, it is in early beta and grows every week. New dungeons, bosses, gear and modes land often; the Recently Added list on this page shows the latest.

## Recently added

- 2026-10-19, **Music**: LDBG has its own soundtrack. A calm loop plays on the title and the menus, and when you step into the Farm or a dungeon the full theme kicks in and keeps going from one activity to the next. Finish a dungeon run and the theme plays out to its ending. Changes always land on the beat. Turn it up or down with the Music slider in Settings.
- 2026-10-19, **The Region Log**: The Endless Dungeon now remembers where you have been. The first time you walk into a region, NEW REGION is stamped over its banner. Open the Region Log from the Endless Dungeon card to see every region: the ones you have found, with who lives there, what they drop and how deep you got, the ones still waiting to be found, and what opens the locked ones. The end-of-run card shows the road you took.
- 2026-10-19, **The Endless Dungeon**: Endless is one dungeon now, made of regions: Greenshore Fields, Bandit Camp, Bandit Town, the Cyclops Arena and the Cultist Tower, plus the Dump once you beat the Garbage Man's third wave and the Slime Grotto once you reach wave 10 of the Slime King's pit. Each region ends in a chest, harder regions hold better chests (the Cultist Tower never pays less than a Masterwork Vault), and the hardest can pay an Arcane Vault or a Royal Chest. The deeper you go, the harder the regions get. The Garbage Man and the Slime King appear as gentler versions of themselves, and deep enemies hit less hard on a messy board. Co-op works too: regions either of you has opened can come up.
- 2026-10-14, **Bosses make an entrance**: Every boss now arrives in style. The Bandit King spins down out of the sky and bounces onto his spot, the Slime King lands with a splat, the Cult Leader whirls out of a burst of dark magic, and the Garbage Man hops in with a bag balanced on his head. Shooty juggles his way on, until the last stone comes down on his head, and Punchy, Bernie and the Cyclops each have a move of their own. The fight starts exactly when it always did.
- 2026-10-13, **Gel Packs**: A new block skin for anyone who maxes out a Slime King run, alone or with a friend: keep going until the game tells you the run has reached its limit. Pouches of coloured gel that squash flat when they land, bulge, and wobble back into place. Slam a piece down and the blocks underneath feel it too, and a line clear lands everything above it with a squish. Fights against him, and every fight, also run lighter: the health bars cost far less to draw while they move.
- 2026-10-13, **Omens, and the Golden Slime King**: Now and then a Slime King walks in golden: beat him for three times his loot and up to 200 coins. And Endless and Dark have Omens. Open 30 chests in Endless or Dark to claim the Omen Seeker feat, then switch Omens on from the Endless and Dark cards. After every third chest an omen takes hold for a few kills: a boon like Wrath, Bounty or Gold Rush, a curse like Frenzy or Thick Hide, or a pact that makes the fight harder and pays far more. Every run with Omens on earns 20% more XP.
- 2026-10-13, **The Slime King's new look**: The Slime King has a whole new body, crown and scowl, and his idol has a new look too: the Goop Idol is now the Ooze Idol, a hardened lump of his ooze, and the ring it makes is now the Oozing Ring. Anything you already own just changes its name. Royal Jelly now wears a little crown, and Thick Slime sits heavy and bubbling.
- 2026-10-12, **A longer look round**: New adventurers who finish the tutorial can now ask to be shown more: every place to play, what each menu is for, and a line or two inside each screen that matters, from your gear to the Upgrade trees. Or say you'll figure it out, and go.
